spans.s: मरक m. A plague, a pestilential disease, an epidemic.
मारक m. 1. A plague, a pestilence; 2. the god of death; 3. a hawk.
मरकत n. An emerald, मरकतमणि
मेदिनी
धरो वा तरुणतरस्तरुरेष वा तमालः Bh.V.iv.33, 34, Sis.iv.56, Megh.ii.13. (The word is sometimes written मरक्त.)
मारकत a. (f. ती) Relating to an emerald.
मरकत-मणि m.f. an emerald.
मरकत-शिला f. an emerald slab.
मरण m. 1. Dying, death, संभावितस्य चाकीर्तिर्मरणादतिरिच्यते Bg.ii.4; 2. a kind of deadly poison.
मारण n. 1. Killing, slaughter, destruction; 2. a magical ceremony for the purpose of destroying an enemy; 3. a kind of poison.
मरण-अंत, -अंतिक a. ending in death.
मरण-अंत, -अंतिक a. ending in death.
मरण-उन्मुख a. on the point of death, moribund.
मरण-धर्मन् a. mortal.
मरत m. Death.
मरंद m. The juice of flowers.
मरंद m. The juice of flowers.
मरंद-ओकस् n. a flower.
मरंद-ओकस् n. a flower.
मरार m. A granary.
मराल (I) a. (f. ला) Greasy, soft.
मराल (II) m. (fem. ˚ली) 1. A goose, a flamingo, Na.vi.72; 2. the Kāraṇḍava bird; 3. collyrium; 4. a horse; 5. a cloud; 6. a rogue, a cheat; 7. a grove of pomegranate trees.
मराल (I) a. (f. ला) Greasy, soft.
मरि(री)च (I) m. The pepper-shrub.
मरि(री)च (II) n. Black pepper.
मरि(री)च (I) m. The pepper-shrub.
मरि(री)च (II) n. Black pepper.
मारिच a. (f. ची) Made of pepper.
मारीच (I) m. 1. Name of a Rākṣasa; 2. a large elephant; 3. a kind of plant.
मारीच (II) n. A collection of pepper-plants.
मरीचि (I) m.f. 1. A ray of light, हुताग्निकल्पैः सवितुर्मरीचिभिः Rt.i.16, R.xiii.4, ix.13; 2. a particle of light; 3. mirage.
मरीचि (II) m. 1. A miser; 2. name of a Prajāpati; 3. name of a law-giver.
मारिच a. (f. ची) Made of pepper.
मरीचि-तोय n. a mirage.
मरीचि-मत् m. the sun.
मरीचि-मालिन् (I) a. radiant, splendid.
मरीचि-मालिन् (II) m. the sun.
मरीचिका f. Mirage.
मरीचिन् m. The sun.
मरीमृज a. (f. जा) Rubbing repeatedly.
मरीमृज a. (f. जा) Rubbing repeatedly.
मरु (I) m. 1. A desert, a wilderness, a conntry destitute of water; 2. a mountain.
मरु (II) m. pl. Name of a country and its people.
मरु-उद्भवा f. 1. a cucumber; 2. the cotton-shrub.
मरु-कच्छ m. name of a district.
मरु-ज m. a kind of perfume.
मरु-देश m. 1. a district destitute of water; 2. name of a country.
मरु-द्विपप्रिय m. a camel.
मरु-धन्व, -धन्वन् m. a wilderness.
मरु-धन्व, -धन्वन् m. a wilderness.
मरु-पथ m. a sandy desert, R.iv.31.
मरु-पृष्ठ n. a sandy desert, R.iv.31.
मरु-भू f. pl. the same as मरु II q.v.
मरु-संभव n. a kind of horse-radish.
मरु-स्थल n. a waste, a desert, a wilderness, तत्प्राप्नोति मरुस्थलेपि नितरां मेरौ ततो नाधिकम् Bhartr.ii.49.
मरु-स्थली f. a waste, a desert, a wilderness, तत्प्राप्नोति मरुस्थलेपि नितरां मेरौ ततो नाधिकम् Bhartr.ii.49.
मरुक m. A peacock.
मरुक m. A kind of duck.
मरूक m. 1. A peacock; 2. kind of deer.
मरुत् (I) m. 1. Wind, air, दिशः प्रसेदुर्मह्रुतो ववुः सुखाः R.iii.14; 2. the deity that presides over wind; 3. a god, मरुतां पश्यतां तस्य शिरांसि पतितान्यपि R.xii.101; 4. the marubaka plant.
मरुत् (II) n. A kind of plant (ग्रंथिपर्ण).
मरुत्-आंदोल m. a kind of fan.
मरुत्-कर m. a kind of bean.
मरुत्-कर्मन् n. flatulency.
मरुत्-क्रिया f. flatulency.
मरुत्-कोण m. the north-west.
मरुत्-गण m. the host of the gods.
मरुत्-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma, the second Pāṇḍava prince.
मरुत्-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma, the second Pāṇḍava prince.
मरुत्-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma, the second Pāṇḍava prince.
मरुत्-तनय, -पुत्र, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma, the second Pāṇḍava prince.
मरुत्-ध्वज n. the down of cotton floating in the air.
मरुत्-पट m. a sail.
मरुत्-पति, -पाल n. an epithet of Indra. See R.viii.32.
मरुत्-पति, -पाल n. an epithet of Indra. See R.viii.32.
मरुत्-पथ m. sky, atmosphere.
मरुत्-प्लव m. a lion.
मरुत्-फल n. hail.
मरुत्-बद्ध m. 1. an epithet of Viṣṇu; 2. particular sacrificial vessel.
मरुत्-रथ m. 1. a car in which idols are taken about; 2. horse.
मरुल्लोक m. the world of the Maruts.
मरुत्वत् m. 1. an epithet of Indra; 2. of Hanūmat; 3. a cloud.
मरुत्-वर्त्मन् n. sky, atmosphere.
मरुत्-वाह m. 1. smoke; 2. fire.
मरुत्-सख m. 1. an epithet of Indra; 2. of fire.
मरुत m. 1. Wind; 2. a god.
मारुत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to the Maruts; 2. relating to wind.
मारुत (II) m. 1. Air, wind, M.iv.122, ix.306, R.ii.12; 2. the deity that presides over wind; 3. wind considered as one of the three humours of the body; 4. the trunk of an elephant.
मारुत (III) n. The constellation Svātī.
मरुत्तक m. The marubaka plant.
मरुव m. 1. Name of a plant; 2. an epithet of Rāhu.
मरुव(ब)क m. 1. A kind of plant; 2. a species of citron; 3. a tiger; 4. Rāhu; 5. a crane.
मरुव(ब)क m. 1. A kind of plant; 2. a species of citron; 3. a tiger; 4. Rāhu; 5. a crane.
मर्कट m. 1. An ape, a monkey, युक्तं सभायां खलु मर्कटानाम् Bh.i.85; 2. a spider; 3. a kind of crane; 4. a mode of sexual enjoyment; 5. a kind of poison.
मर्कट-आस्य (I) a. monkey-faced.
मर्कट-आस्य (II) n. copper.
मर्कट-इंदु m. ebony.
मर्कट-तिंदुक m. a kind of ebony.
मर्कट-पोत m. a young monkey.
मर्कट-वास m. a cobweb.
मर्कट-शीर्ष n. vermilion.
मर्कटक m. 1. An ape; 2. a spider; 3. a kind of fish; 4. a kind of grain.
मर्करा f. 1. A pot, a vessel; 2. a cavern, a hollow; 3. a barren woman.
मर्च् vt. 10U (pres. मर्चयति-ते) 1. To take; 2. to cleanse.
मर्जु (I) m. 1. A washerman; 2. a catamite.
मर्जु (II) f. Cleanliness, purification.
मर्त m. 1. A man, a human being; 2. the earth, the world of mortals.
मर्त्य (I) a. (f. र्त्या) Mortal.
मर्त्य (II) m. 1. A mortal, a human being, M.i.84; 2. the world of mortals, the earth.
मर्त्य (III) n. The body.
मर्त्य (I) a. (f. र्त्या) Mortal.
मार्त्य n. Mortality.
मर्त्य-धर्मन् a. mortal.
मर्त्य-निवासिन् m. a mortal, a human being.
मर्त्य-भुवन n. the earth.
मर्त्य-महित m. a gol.
मर्त्य-मुख m. a kinnara, a being with the figure of an animal and the head of a man; (these beings are said to be the attendants of Kubera).
मर्त्य-लोक m. the world of mortals, the earth, क्षीणे पुण्यं मर्त्यलोकं विशंति Bg.ix.21.
मर्द m. 1. A violent stroke; 2. grinding, crushing.
मर्दन n. 1. Rubbing, shampooing; 2. crushing, grinding; 3. pressing; 4. devastating; 5. paining, afflicting.
मर्दल m. A kind of drum, अशनिशब्दमर्दलः Rt.ii.1.
मर्ब् vt. 1P (pres. मर्बति) To go, to move.

मर्मन् n. 1. A vital part of the human body, a vital member of the body, सप्तोत्तरं मर्मशतं द्वे च संधिशते तथा Yaj.iii.102, Bt.xvi.15; 2. a weak point, a vulnerable point, a defect; 3. the joint of a limb; 4. pith, essence, hidden meaning (as in गुरुमर्मप्रकाश, the title of Nāgojībhaṭṭa’s gloss on the Rasagangādhara); 5. a secret, a mystery.
मर्मन्-अतिग a. piercing deeply into the vitals.
मर्मन्-अन्वेषण n. seeking vulnerable points, looking out for defects.
मर्मन्-आवरण n. a coat of mail.
मर्मन्-आविध् a. piercing the vitals.
मर्मन्-कील m. a husband.
मर्मन्-ग a. poignant.
मर्मन्-घ्न a. striking the vitals.
मर्मन्-चर n. the heart.
मर्मन्-च्छिद्, -भिद् a. striking the vitals, wounding mortally.
मर्मन्-च्छिद्, -भिद् a. striking the vitals, wounding mortally.
मर्मन्-ज्ञ (I) a. 1. familiar with the most secret portions of a subject; 2. exceedingly clever, having a deep insight into anything; 3. knowing the weak points of another.
मर्मन्-ज्ञ (II) m. an acute and learned man.
मर्मन्-त्र n. a coat of mail.
मर्मन्-पारग a. thoroughly conversant with, having a deep insight into.
मर्मन्-भेद m. 1. piercing the vitals; 2. disclosing the secrets or weak points of another.
मर्मन्-भेदन, -भेदिन् m. an arrow.
मर्मन्-भेदन, -भेदिन् m. an arrow.
मर्मन्-विद् a. 1. knowing weak points; 2. knowing the secret parts of any subject.
मर्मन्-स्थल, -स्थान n. 1. a vital part; 2. a weak point.
मर्मन्-स्थल, -स्थान n. 1. a vital part; 2. a weak point.
मर्मन्-स्पृश् a. 1. touching the vitals; 2. sharp, poignant, stinging, cutting (lit. and fig.).
मर्मर (I) a. (f. रा) Rustling, अनेन सार्धं विहरांबुराशेस्तीरेषु तालीवनमर्मरेषु R.vi.57, xix.41, K.S.iii.31.
मर्मर (II) m. A rustling sound.
मर्मर (I) a. (f. रा) Rustling, अनेन सार्धं विहरांबुराशेस्तीरेषु तालीवनमर्मरेषु R.vi.57, xix.41, K.S.iii.31.
मर्मरी f. 1. A species of pine tree; 2. turmeric.
मर्मरीक m. 1. A poor man; 2. a wicked man.
मर्या f. A limit, a boundary.

मर्यादा f. 1. A limit, boundary, a terminus, मर्यादायाः प्रभेदे च सीमातिक्रमणे तथा Yaj.ii.155; 2. a shore, a bank; 3. the bounds of morality, fixed uaago, moral law; 4. decorum of behaviour, propriety of conduct; 5. an agreement, a covenant.
मर्यादा-अचल, -गिरि, -पर्वत m. a frontier mountain.
मर्यादा-अचल, -गिरि, -पर्वत m. a frontier mountain.
मर्यादा-अचल, -गिरि, -पर्वत m. a frontier mountain.
मर्यादिन् m. A neighbour, a borderer.
मर्व् vt. 1P (pres. मर्वति) 1. To go, to move; 2. to fill.
मर्श m. 1. Counsel, advice, deliberation; 2. a sternutatory.
मर्ष m. Endurance, patience, forbearance.
मार्ष m. The same as मारिष q.v.
मर्शन n. 1. Examination, inquiry; 2. counsel, deliberation; 3. rubbing, touching; 4. rubbing off.
मर्षण n. Endurance, patience, forbearance.
मर्षित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Endured, borne patiently; 2. forgiven.
मर्षित (II) n. Patience, endurance.
मर्षित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Endured, borne patiently; 2. forgiven.

मार m. 1. Killing, slaughter, श्यामात्मा कुटिलः करोतु कबरीभारोऽपि मारोद्यमम् Git.G.iii.; 2. opposition, impediment; 3. the god of love; 4. love, passion; 5. the thorn-apple; 6. the devil, the evil one (in Buddhistic works).
मार-अंक a. displaying tokens of love, मारांके रतिकेलिसंकुलरणारंभे Git.G.xii.
मार-अभिभु m. an epithet of Buddha.
मार-अरि m. an epithet of Śiva.
मार-आत्मक a. murderous.
मार-जित् m. an epithet of Buddha.
मारकत a. (f. ती) Relating to an emerald.
मारि f. 1. A pestilence, a plague; 2. ruin.
मारी f. 1. A plague, a pestilence; 2. the goddess supposed to preside over epidemics.
मारिष m. A respectable person, a venerable man. (In dramatic language, this word is applied to one of the principal actors in the prelude. See Ut.i., M.M.i.)
मारुंड m. 1. Cow-dung; 2. a serpent’s egg; 3. a road.
मारुत (I) a. (f. ती) 1. Relating to the Maruts; 2. relating to wind.
मारुति m. 1. An epithet of Hanūmat, R.xii.60; 2. of Bhīma.
मारुत-अशन m. a snake.
मारुत-आत्मज, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
मारुत-आत्मज, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
मारुत-आत्मज, -सुत, -सूनु m. 1. an epithet of Hanūmat; 2. of Bhīma.
मार्कंड m. Name of an ancient sage.
मार्कंड m. Name of an ancient sage.
मार्कंड-पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.
मार्कंड-पुराण n. name of one of the eighteen Purāṇas.

मार्ग् (I) vt. 1P, 10U (pres. मार्गति, मार्गयति-ते) 1. To seek, to seek for; 2. to strive to obtain; 3. to strive after, e.g. आत्मोत्कर्षं न मार्गेत परेषां परिनिंदया; 4. to solicit, to beg, वरं वरेण्यो नृपतेरमार्गीत् Bt.i.12; 5. to ask in marriage.
मार्ग् (II) vt. 10U (pres. मार्गयति-ते) 1. To go, to move; 2. to adorn, to decorate.With परि-, to look for, to seek.

मार्ग m. 1. Way, road, path, track, मार्गं तावच्छृणु कथयतस्तत्प्रयाणानुरूपम् Megh.i.13, R.ii.72; 2. passage, passing over, सारंगास्ते जललवमुचः सूचयिष्यंति मार्गम् Megh.i.21; 3. search, inquiry, inrestigation; 4. the path of a planet; 5. the anus; 6. a means; 7. the right way, the proper course to follow, Cf. अमार्ग; 8. mode, method, course, manner, usage, R.vii.71; 9. style, diction, वाचां विचित्रमार्गाणां निबबंधुः क्रियाविधिम् K.D.i.9; 10. musk; 11. the constellation मृगशिरस्; 12. the month Mārgaśīrṣa.
मार्ग-तोरण n. an arch erected over a road, R.xi.5.
मार्ग-दर्शक m. a guide.
मार्ग-धेनु m. a meant of distance equal to four koś.
मार्ग-धेनुक n. a meant of distance equal to four koś.
मार्ग-रक्षक m. a guard, a road-keeper.
मार्ग-स्थ a. travelling.
मार्ग-हर्म्य n. a palace on a high road.
मार्गक m. The month Mārgaśīrṣa.
मार्गण (I) m. 1. A beggar, a mendicant; 2. an arrow, अहितरोपितमार्गणम् R.i.17, 65; 3. the number ‘five.’
मार्गण (II) n. 1. Begging, soliciting; 2. searching, lookine for; 3. investigation, inquiry.
मार्गणा f. The same as मार्गण q.v.
मार्गशिर m. Name of that lunar month in which the full moon is in the constellation मृगशिरस्, Bg.x.35.
मार्गशिर m. Name of that lunar month in which the full moon is in the constellation मृगशिरस्, Bg.x.35.
मार्गशिर m. Name of that lunar month in which the full moon is in the constellation मृगशिरस्, Bg.x.35.
मार्गशिरी f. the full-moon day in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa.
मार्गशिरी f. the full-moon day in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa.
मार्गिक m. 1. A traveller; 2. a hunter.
मार्गित a. (f. ता) Sought, searched, inquired after.
मार्गित a. (f. ता) Sought, searched, inquired after.
मार्ज् vt. or vt. 10U (pres. मार्जयति-ते) 1. To clean, to purify, to cleanse; 2. to sound.
मार्ज m. 1. Cleansing, purifying; 2. a washerman; 3. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
मार्जक a. (f. र्जिका) Cleaning, cleansing, purifying.
मार्जक a. (f. र्जिका) Cleaning, cleansing, purifying.
मार्जन (I) n. 1. Cleaning, cleansing; 2. wiping, rubbing off, effacing; 3. cleansing the person by rubbing it with unguents; 4. sprinkling the body with consecrated water, Yaj.i.22.
मार्जन (II) m. The lodhra tree.
मार्जना f. 1. Cleaning, purifying; 2. the sound of a drum.
मार्जनी f. A broom, a brush.
मार्जार(ल) m. 1. A cat, M.iv.126; 2. a pole-cat.
मार्जार(ल) m. 1. A cat, M.iv.126; 2. a pole-cat.
मार्जार(ल)-कंठ m. a peacock.
मार्जार(ल)-कंठ m. a peacock.
मार्जार(ल)-करण n. particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
मार्जार(ल)-करण n. particular mode of sexual enjoyment.
मार्जारक m. 1. A cat; 2. a peacock.
मार्जारी f. 1. A female cat; 2. musk.
मार्जारीय m. 1. A cat; 2. a Śūdra.
मार्जित a. (f. ता) 1. Cleansed, purified; 2. swept, brushed.
मार्जित a. (f. ता) 1. Cleansed, purified; 2. swept, brushed.
मार्जिता f. Curds with sugar and spices.
मार्तंड m. 1. The sun, मार्तंडोऽयमुदेति केन पशुना लोके शशांकीकृतः Bh.V.ii.91; 2. the arka plant; 3. a hog; 4. the number ‘twelve.’ (Also मार्तांड.)
मार्तिक (I) a. (f. की) Made of clay, earthen.
मार्तिक (II) m. 1. A kind of pitcher; 2. the lid of a pitcher.
मार्तिक (III) n. A clod of earth, a potsherd, मार्तिकशकलैर्निहंतुकामं माम् Bh.V.ii.49.
मार्तिक (I) a. (f. की) Made of clay, earthen.
मार्दंग (I) m. A drummer.
मार्दंग (II) n. A city, a town.
मार्दंगिक m. A drummer.
मार्दव n. 1. Tenderness, weakness, तदानपेक्ष्य स्वशरीरमार्दवम् K.S.v.18; 2. leniency, mildness, gentleness, kindness, Bg.xvi.2.(मार्दवं भज् ‘to relent.’)
मार्द्वीक (I) a. (f. की) Made of grapes.
मार्द्वीक (II) n. Wine.
मार्द्वीक (I) a. (f. की) Made of grapes.
मार्ष्टि f. Cleaning, cleansing, purifying.
